provider.title: AI provider
provider.description: gemini or openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Azure proxy).

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Organization Gemini key. Use a paid-tier key for student records so data is not used for model training.

permissionMode.title: Forced permission mode
permissionMode.description: review = approve every action, smart = approve risky actions, auto = full autopilot.

allowAutopilot.title: Allow autopilot
allowAutopilot.description: When false, users cannot pick full autopilot for web tasks or auto-post grades.

blockedSites.title: Blocked sites
blockedSites.description: Hostnames where DoTask must never act (for example payroll.example.com).
